notes: Read SKILL.md and references/mcp-contract.md in full. Vendor-authored (Helena Bioinformatics) workflow for the hosted Folklore Clinical Variant Interpretation MCP: resolve one public GRCh38 germline SNV/indel, branch strictly on resolved/ambiguous/not_found/invalid_request/unsupported/resolution_unavailable, chain into variant literature, publication details, corpus search, and ClinGen gene-disease assertions, with provenance and a professional-review boundary statement.

The agent connects to the MCP endpoint or runs curl JSON-RPC POSTs (SKILL.md:35-44, references/mcp-contract.md:27-35) against https://api.helena.bio/folklore/v1/mcp; no account, API key, package install or file write is involved, and all calls are read-only lookups. Medium because the agent sends queries to a live third-party service in a clinical-adjacent domain; acceptable because the skill enforces strict data minimization (SKILL.md:72-86, 222-223: remove or refuse patient, phenotype, family and private case data) and forbids presenting results as diagnosis or treatment advice.

Optional pointers to other skills (`database-lookup`, `genomic-coordinates`, SKILL.md:61-64) are not bundled and are not required. The missing-path signals for `tools/list`/`tools/call` are MCP JSON-RPC method names, not files. The `support_helena` tool (SKILL.md:104) is to be used only when explicitly requested. Content is dated to adapter 1.5.0 / protocol 2026-07-28.
